text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Rulership-senpai, Trainer-san.
I'm so sorry for suddenly coming up to talk to you
during the Fan Appreciation Festival...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
When I heard you were feeling down, Ruler-senpai,
I just couldn't, couldn't, couldn't
hold myself back!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm super happy that we got some time to talk again like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kiseki is widely known as a manga-loving Umamusume, but...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-senpai, I've been
following all your races!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the serialization started, all this time!
The one that remains most deeply in my memory is...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That heated battle against Eishin Flash-senpai
in the Japanese Derby was so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Bring it on, Flash!
I'll take you down with my strategy!)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The clash between Flash-senpai unleashing her special move and Ruler-senpai shutting it down was amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You say it was amazing... but did you actually understand it?
That hidden, high-stakes battle beneath the surface
that isn't obvious at first glance?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I can read minds like an open book!
I always daydream a hundred scenarios
about who's scheming what, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And the post-race line...
"Our game has only just begun."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You were so cool~...!
I said it over and over on the way home.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Also, starting this year,
that spin-off race was great too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after the rival she couldn't face, right into the Nikkei Shinshun Hai.
Now isn't that an insanely hype development?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
How was it, Rose? Facing off against me.
I had a blast, but did it fire you up too?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series is... a good game.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The Twinkle Series is a great game."
That definitely deserves a Quote of the Year award!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There are so many other races I've gone to see...
Every single one of them was just so deeply moving!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kiseki speaks passionately. What I can gather is...
choice_data_list: You really... were paying attention all along, weren't you?
You really were... watching me all along, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course! I saw it at the racetrack, and I've rewatched the video so many times!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you had just skimmed through it, you wouldn't have such detailed thoughts.
Kiseki really seems to look up to Rulership.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's... past glory, though.
The me of today is...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A mediocre player and a failed ruler.
I have no value at all...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "That is!! Not true!!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even now, Ruler-senpai,
you're still the one closest to the top!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The pinnacle...? Me...?
Even after the sheer difference in influence was made painfully clear in Dubai?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even so!
Because...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
What makes you so amazing, Ruler-senpai,
isn't just that you're strong.
It's that you're so exciting every single time!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Races have strategies! Logic!
Challenges! Trials!
And on top of that...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Winning at the very end with an unexpected secret plan!
That's why the readers get so hooked!
It makes you want to read it week after week!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The one who writes the most interesting story is the top author. That is why...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're the Umamusume closest to being a true ruler,
Ruler-senpai. That's what I believe!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...?
I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki's momentum is incredible.
Just listening to her... makes me caught up in the exact same feeling...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, I'm completely captivated by Ruler-senpai's races. That's why...!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Please cheer up! I'll always
look forward to your next work, Sensei!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kiseki's visit brought a faint spark of vitality
to Rulership, who was at rock bottom.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's quite a surprise.
I've had people praise my "strategies" before, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: To think someone would passionately argue that the greatest strength is "flashy play."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Being seen like that isn't so bad, I suppose... but it doesn't quite click with me."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What I strive to be is ruler of the board.
Yet the image Kiseki holds is almost like...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Isn't she an esports star player?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Are you saying my aptitude is higher for that...? I've never even considered it, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Even if I were to become a star player, there's still one major problem.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Aside from competitions, those kinds of folks
get invited to all sorts of events, right?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I really hate going outside, y'know~~~?
Getting dragged around everywhere is the last thing I want~~~."
choice_data_list: Ah, I see how it is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership is more the type to pull the strings
from the shadows, rather than standing out
in the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, even so, should I make my comeback
as a star player?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't give an immediate answer.
Instead...
choice_data_list: I think we just have to figure things out as we go, race by race.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
Honestly, I'm still feeling a bit out of it, but...
I did make a promise to Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll throw everything I've got into the Takarazuka Kinen
and search for the answer there."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
After aspiring to be a ruler and failing...
what could I ever become now...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after tasting defeat, Rulership began searching for a new image of herself.
